key: COREY: So you found me after all.
en: COREY: So you found me after all.
ja: コーリー: やはり、見つけたか。

key: You've already ruined everything I've worked for.
en: You've already ruined everything I've worked for.
ja: お前はすでに、私が築いてきたすべてを台無しにした。

key: What more do you want?
en: What more do you want?
ja: これ以上、何を望むと言うのだ?

key: ...No, perhaps it is wrong to blame you.
en: ...No, perhaps it is wrong to blame you.
ja: ……いや、お前を責めるのは筋違いかもしれん。

key: Once again, words are pointless.
en: Once again, words are pointless.
ja: 言葉など、もはや無意味だ。

key: Miserable as it is for an old man backed into a corner like me to make requests,
en: Miserable as it is for an old man backed into a corner like me to make requests,
ja: 追い詰められた老いぼれが頼み事をするなど、みっともない話だが、

key: There is something I must ask of you.
en: There is something I must ask of you.
ja: お前に頼みたいことがある。

key: I'll return to the arena.
en: I'll return to the arena.
ja: 私は闘技場に戻る。

key: There, you should defeat me properly.
en: There, you should defeat me properly.
ja: そこで、正々堂々と私を倒すがいい。

key: A card-scanner sits on the wall.
en: A card-scanner sits on the wall.
ja: 壁にカードスキャナーが設置されている。

key: \PN tried the Silver Card!
en: \PN tried the Silver Card!
ja: \PNはぎんのカードを試した!

key: Heather is fast asleep.
en: Heather is fast asleep.
ja: ヘザーはぐっすり眠っている。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 11!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 11!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解析データ11を手に入れた!

key: Info on Corrosive Mist Field now available!
en: Info on Corrosive Mist Field now available!
ja: 腐食霧フィールドの情報が閲覧可能になった!

key: HEATHER: ...Well, it looks exactly the same as when I left.
en: HEATHER: ...Well, it looks exactly the same as when I left.
ja: ヘザー: ……ふん、出ていった時のまんまね。

key: HEATHER: Dustier, though.
en: HEATHER: Dustier, though.
ja: ヘザー: ほこりっぽくはなったけど。

key: How long has it been since I stopped sleeping here?
en: How long has it been since I stopped sleeping here?
ja: ここで眠らなくなってから、どれくらい経つのかな。

key: HEATHER: Man, I haven't read these in forever.
en: HEATHER: Man, I haven't read these in forever.
ja: ヘザー: うわ、これ読まなくなってからずいぶん経つな。

key: Oh! "The Adventures of Gligirl!"
en: Oh! "The Adventures of Gligirl!"
ja: あっ!「グライガール大冒険」!

key: Have you ever read these?
en: Have you ever read these?
ja: これ、読んだことある?

key: I bet there's a bunch of new issues by now!
en: I bet there's a bunch of new issues by now!
ja: 今頃、新刊がいっぱい出てるんだろうな!

key: HEATHER: ...Most of this stuff wasn't even really mine.
en: HEATHER: ...Most of this stuff wasn't even really mine.
ja: ヘザー: ……ここにあるものの大半、実はあたしのものですらなかったのよね。

key: HEATHER: And this was my bed.
en: HEATHER: And this was my bed.
ja: ヘザー: それで、これがあたしのベッド。

key: It's nice and soft, but I was always more comfortable on Salamence's back.
en: It's nice and soft, but I was always more comfortable on Salamence's back.
ja: ふかふかで気持ちいいけど、あたしはいつもボーマンダの背中の方が落ち着いたわ。

key: HEATHER: Why do adults always have more things than friends?
en: HEATHER: Why do adults always have more things than friends?
ja: ヘザー: なんで大人って、友達より物の方が多いんだろ。

key: What's the point of any of this?
en: What's the point of any of this?
ja: こんなもの、何の意味があるって言うのよ。

key: HEATHER: This is where I ate meals.
en: HEATHER: This is where I ate meals.
ja: ヘザー: ここでご飯を食べてたの。

key: He'd get mad if I ate in my room, but he'd eat in his room all the time.
en: He'd get mad if I ate in my room, but he'd eat in his room all the time.
ja: あたしが部屋で食べたら怒るくせに、自分はしょっちゅう部屋で食べてたわ。

key: But, I usually hoped he would.
en: But, I usually hoped he would.
ja: でも、大抵はそうしてほしいと思ってた。

key: I preferred to be alone too.
en: I preferred to be alone too.
ja: あたしも、一人の方が良かったから。

key: HEATHER: I didn't go in here much.
en: HEATHER: I didn't go in here much.
ja: ヘザー: ここにはあんまり入らなかったな。

key: HEATHER: It feels wrong now too.
en: HEATHER: It feels wrong now too.
ja: ヘザー: 今でも、何か落ち着かない。

key: HEATHER: And this was Dad's office.
en: HEATHER: And this was Dad's office.
ja: ヘザー: それで、これがパパの書斎。

key: HEATHER: There's a trick here...
en: HEATHER: There's a trick here...
ja: ヘザー: ここに何か仕掛けがあるのよ……

key: HEATHER: This was Dad's office.
en: HEATHER: This was Dad's office.
ja: ヘザー: これがパパの書斎だったの。

key: HEATHER: He spent most of his time in here.
en: HEATHER: He spent most of his time in here.
ja: ヘザー: パパ、ほとんどの時間をここで過ごしてたわ。

key: HEATHER: "For Heather,
en: HEATHER: "For Heather,
ja: ヘザー: 「ヘザーへ、

key: By the time you read this, you will be strong..."
en: By the time you read this, you will be strong..."
ja: これを読む頃には、お前は強くなっているだろう……」

key: HEATHER: As if.
en: HEATHER: As if.
ja: ヘザー: どうだか。

key: "Being strong" was just the excuse he used to keep himself locked up.
en: "Being strong" was just the excuse he used to keep himself locked up.
ja: 「強くなる」なんて、パパが自分を閉じ込めておくための言い訳にすぎなかった。

key: Rather than being strong, isn't it better to learn to care for others?
en: Rather than being strong, isn't it better to learn to care for others?
ja: 強くなることより、他人を思いやることを学ぶ方が、よっぽど大事なんじゃないの?

key: He was as weak and scared as any other kid.
en: He was as weak and scared as any other kid.
ja: パパだって、他のどんな子供とも同じくらい弱くて、怖がってたのよ。

key: If only he knew how to show it.
en: If only he knew how to show it.
ja: それを見せる方法さえ知っていれば良かったのに。

key: HEATHER: So it's settled!
en: HEATHER: So it's settled!
ja: ヘザー: よし、決めた!

key: That's the kind of heroine I'm going to be!
en: That's the kind of heroine I'm going to be!
ja: あたしは、そういうヒロインになるわ!

key: Any old clown in a suit can punch a villain and call it a day,
en: Any old clown in a suit can punch a villain and call it a day,
ja: スーツを着たそこらのピエロだって、悪者をぶん殴って終わりにできるでしょうけど、

key: But who are the ones practicing true compassion?!
en: But who are the ones practicing true compassion?!
ja: 本当の思いやりを実践してるのは、一体誰なのよ?!

key: That's a job only a magical wind maiden can do!
en: That's a job only a magical wind maiden can do!
ja: それができるのは、魔法の風の乙女だけなんだから!
